conviction_note: Two negative findings (-4.0 revenue exit-rate decay into a mandatory FY27 guide, -2.5 an unwindable +4.70% pop on a procurement agreement misframed as a demand win) net against one genuinely positive balance-sheet finding (+1.5, the $50m ATM is undrawn), summing to -5.0, which sits well inside the 7.79% median historical reaction and deliberately below the unusable 13.05% option-implied move.

findings.finding: Aeluma's own narrowed FY26 guide of $4.2-4.6m against nine-month revenue of $3.879m implies a Q4 of $321-721k, so the fiscal-year quarterly sequence is $1.4m -> $1.3m -> $1.2m -> ~$0.59m (a 58% decline across the year), FY26 revenue will be the company's first-ever annual DECLINE ($4.2-4.6m vs FY25's $4.7m), and the FY2027 guidance the company must issue tonight has to be anchored to an exit run-rate annualising to ~$2.3m against a ~$245m market cap (18,305,335 shares x $13.375), i.e. ~104x exit-rate revenue.
findings.why_not_priced: The Q4 revenue number itself IS priced - four analysts carry $586.5k, squarely inside the implied $321-721k band, so I am not claiming the quarter surprises. What is not priced is the second half of the event: the initial FY2027 guide, and the fact that the exit rate it must be built from is a 58%-decayed quarter. If that were priced, the two covering analysts would not still carry an average $25.50 target (+91% on a $13.375 spot) with no cut since the guide was narrowed on 2026-05-13, and the 25-delta skew would not be -11.04 vol points with 'upside paid' into a company that has fallen on 5 of its last 6 prints. The directly comparable event - the FY2025 print on 2025-09-09, which also carried FY results plus an initial next-year guide - was -27.47%. Note the specific tail: because the FY26 exit rate makes any growth guide hard to defend, the company may decline to guide FY27 at all, and a withheld guide is read as a cut.
findings.independence: The 4-analyst consensus Q4 revenue of $586.5k, from a different source, independently confirms the arithmetic of the implied quarter (https://www.fxempire.com/stocks/almu/earnings). Separately, the mechanism the company blamed for the May guide cut - 'delays in execution of contracts, due to government shutdowns' - is live again into FY27: federal funding runs on a continuing resolution signed 2026-09-02 through 2026-12-11, and CRs restrict new programme starts, which is how Aeluma's government-contract revenue is originated (https://www.congress.gov/bill/119th-congress/house-bill/5371). FY25 comparatives ($4.7m full year, $1.3m Q4) are from the FY25 release, a third document: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1828805/000121390025086205/ea025633601ex99-1_aeluma.htm

findings.finding: The Sumitomo Chemical Advanced Technologies agreement announced 2026-09-15, one trading day before the print, is a procurement agreement in which SCAT supplies epiwafers TO Aeluma using SCAT's own Phoenix MOCVD tools - the trade press headline is literally 'Sumitomo Chemical Advanced Technologies to provide epiwafers for Aeluma' - yet it carries no disclosed financial terms, volumes or exclusivity, the SCAT relationship was already public in April 2026, and the stock took +4.70% on it (close $12.54 on 09-14 to $13.13 on 09-15).
findings.why_not_priced: The market paid +4.70% for a headline that is a cost line, not a revenue line - Aeluma is buying wafer capacity, not selling it. If the direction of payment had been read correctly the move would not have happened, and the retail-facing coverage would not be tagged 'Very Positive' with no negative points listed (stocktitan). That +4.70% is the single largest up-day in the last three weeks and it is sitting directly under the print with nothing behind it: no contract value, no minimum volume, no term. It is the most reversible part of the current price, and it is what makes the entry level look better than the fundamentals justify. Note also the timing - a partnership headline placed one session before a fiscal-year-end print is a cushion, and it has now been spent.
findings.independence: The company's own 2026-05-13 Q3 release already listed 'Announced Partnerships with Tower Semiconductor and Sumitomo Chemical Advanced Technologies for Wafer Production and Fabrication' among its highlights, so the relationship was public five months earlier - a different document: https://www.aeluma.com/investors/news-events/press-releases/detail/105/aeluma-announces-third-quarter-fiscal-2026-financial-results. PARTIAL OVERLAP DISCLOSURE: this finding and finding 1 both bear on the same thesis (the narrative is running ahead of the revenue), but they rest on entirely different documents and different facts - finding 1 is guidance arithmetic from the May release, this is the direction of payment in a September supply agreement plus a specific one-day price move. Neither uses the other's number.

findings.finding: The $50,000,000 ATM launched 2026-03-20 is essentially undrawn: shares outstanding were 18,305,335 on 2026-08-26 per the shares-outstanding field of Steven DenBaars' Form 144, against 18,002,949 on 2026-03-17 per the 424B5 cover - just +302,386 shares (+1.7%) across five months, consistent with equity compensation alone, where a meaningfully used $50m programme would have issued roughly 3.5m shares.
findings.why_not_priced: Share count between 10-Q filings is published nowhere and is aggregated by nobody; I recovered it from a field on a Form 144 that exists to report an unrelated insider sale. For a nano-cap that put a $50m shelf takedown in place in March and has since fallen 57.5% from its 52-week high, 'did they dilute into this?' is the standing fear ahead of a 10-K, and the answer is no. Paired with cash that was near flat over two quarters ($38.1m at 2025-09-30 to $37.8m at 2026-03-31) and no debt, the 10-K should land with no going-concern language and multi-year runway. If the market already knew this, the name would not trade with the financing discount it carries. This cuts AGAINST my own two negative findings and I am filing it because it is the honest read: it removes the worst tail from tonight, which is why my net number is well inside the historical median move rather than at it.
findings.independence: Cash trajectory is corroborated by a separate document, the Q1 FY26 release reporting $38.1m at 2025-09-30 versus $15.7m at 2025-06-30: https://www.globenewswire.com/news-release/2025/11/12/3186843/0/en/Aeluma-Announces-First-Quarter-Fiscal-2026-Financial-Results.html. The 424B5 baseline share count is a third document: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1828805/000121390026032418/ea0282751-424b5_aeluma.htm

searched_and_found_nothing: Insider-sale signal is dead on inspection: the widely-reported DenBaars 25,000-share sale on 2026-08-26/27 was reported by secondary coverage as having 'no Rule 10b5-1 plan', but the Form 144 itself states it was made pursuant to a plan adopted 2025-11-20, so it carries no information (the 4/A amendment filed the same day is consistent with a checkbox correction)

USAspending.gov keyword search for post-2026-06-30 federal obligations to Aeluma returned no usable content through the fetch tool; SBIR.gov award search would not filter to the recipient - so I could not confirm or refute new government bookings from award data, only from the absence of company announcements

Wayback Machine comparison of the careers page (snapshot 20260410094605 exists) was blocked by egress policy, so the 12 currently-open roles - which skew heavily to test/assembly/reliability, a production-qualification pattern rather than R&D - could not be dated or differenced against April, and I have therefore filed no hiring finding

No definitive CHIPS R&D award for Aeluma has been announced; the 2026-07-29 item remains an LOI expressly subject to due diligence and execution of definitive documents. This is a real upside tail rather than nothing - Commerce/NIST finalised GlobalFoundries' CHIPS R&D award in September 2026, so conversions are happening (https://www.nist.gov/news-events/news/2026/09/department-commerce-announces-finalization-chips-rd-award-globalfoundries) - and it is the main reason my impact_high bands are not tighter

Short interest sources contradict each other irreconcilably (3.6m shares / 23.5% of float versus 1.11m / 11.83%, implying incompatible float figures), so I could not source a number I trust and have left it out of every finding rather than size against it; note a double-digit short base would cap downside and create squeeze risk
No 8-K, S-3, 424B5 or any other filing exists between 2026-07-30 and today, so there is no quiet pre-print disclosure to find
No customer-forum, app-store or channel check is possible - Aeluma has no commercial shipping product, revenue is a handful of government and development R&D contracts
baseline_tension: My negative net cuts hard against the option skew (-11.04 vol points, 'upside paid') and against the repo's free control (-run_up_20d_pct = +16.77 ranks ALMU as a long), and agrees only with the reaction history that is already in the baseline (5 of 6 prints down, and the directly comparable FY-end print -27.47%) - so the edge I am claiming is not the base rate but the specific combination of a mandatory FY27 guide anchored to a 58%-decayed exit quarter and an unwindable +4.70% pop on a supply agreement the market read backwards, partly offset by a dilution tail I can show is closed.
